boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Muhlenberg destinations for studying, gathering, performances, exhibitions, and hands-on learning.

cards.title: Trexler Library
cards.subtitle: Research, group work, and quiet study
cards.notes: Choose a floor to match the task: the library provides spaces ranging from collaborative areas to silent independent study, plus research help.
cards.short_summary: A three-floor library built for different study modes and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Trexler Library offers noisy collaborative work, silent independent study, and workspaces from carrels to couches and bean bag chairs.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary; the College states that Muhlenberg ID is required to enter after 8 p.m.

cards.entity_name: J. Conrad and Hazel J. Seegers Union
cards.title: Seegers Union
cards.subtitle: Campus events, food, and meet-ups
cards.notes: Use the Event Space or Red Door Cafe for a campus program, then settle in where students eat, socialize, study, and connect.
cards.short_summary: A central student union combining events, dining, and study time.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg describes Seegers Union as a place where students eat, socialize, attend events, and study.
cards.access_notes: The information desk is listed as open daily from 9 a.m. to 11 p.m.; individual venues and events may differ.

cards.entity_name: Fahy Commons for Public Engagement and Innovation
cards.title: Fahy Commons
cards.subtitle: Programming space above Cedar Beach Park
cards.notes: Look for campus programming in its gathering areas, or use the building as a visible stop between the arts buildings and Parkway Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A 2023 academic and student-programming building on the hillside.
cards.evidence_claim: Fahy Commons opened in January 2023 with more than 20,000 square feet of student programming and academic space.
cards.access_notes: Use of rooms and programmed areas depends on campus scheduling.

cards.title: Martin Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Baker Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Drop in during public gallery hours to view rotating exhibitions, then use the show details to find artist talks, receptions, or related programs.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery with a permanent collection and rotating public exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Martin Art Gallery presents free, public exhibitions and programming and employs student gallery assistants.
cards.access_notes: Listed public hours are Tuesday through Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.; closed during College holidays.

cards.entity_name: Baker Center for the Arts Galleria
cards.title: Baker Center Galleria
cards.subtitle: Art displays in the Baker Center atrium
cards.notes: Walk through the atrium exhibition area between classes or before an arts event, and pause with the changing displays from the College collection.
cards.short_summary: An atrium-accessible exhibition area that can show multiple works at once.
cards.evidence_claim: The Martin Art Gallery identifies the Galleria as a primary exhibition area that holds multiple exhibitions and permanent-collection works simultaneously.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition spaces are accessible through the Baker Center atrium; displays change.

cards.title: Miller Forum
cards.subtitle: Moyer Hall speaker and event venue
cards.notes: Check the College calendar for a lecture or public event, then arrive with time to find seating in this large Moyer Hall gathering space.
cards.short_summary: A Moyer Hall forum used for guest lectures and other public events.
cards.evidence_claim: Moyer Hall's Miller Forum frequently accommodates guest lecturers and other public events.
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent; confirm the specific program's location and attendance details.

cards.title: Recital Hall
cards.subtitle: Baker Center for the Arts music venue
cards.notes: Watch the music calendar for student recitals, guest-artist sessions, and concerts held in this Baker Center performance room.
cards.short_summary: A named music-performance venue hosting student and visiting artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg's music schedule lists student recitals and music events in Recital Hall at the Baker Center for the Arts.
cards.access_notes: Performance access and start times depend on the published music-events schedule.

cards.title: Paul C. Empie Theatre
cards.subtitle: Baker Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Use the performance calendar to find a theatre, ensemble, or student-composer program, and plan around the event's separate ticket details.
cards.short_summary: A 392-seat campus theatre used by the Theatre and Dance department.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies the Paul C. Empie Theatre as a 392-seat stadium-style theatre among its Theatre and Dance facilities.
cards.access_notes: Venue access is tied to scheduled performances and events; ticket requirements can vary.

cards.title: Studio Theatre
cards.subtitle: Trexler Pavilion for Theatre & Dance
cards.notes: Look for a smaller-scale production or concert in the Trexler Pavilion, where the flexible seating makes each program's layout part of the visit.
cards.short_summary: A flexible black-box performance space in Trexler Pavilion.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg describes the Studio Theatre as a black-box-style space with flexible seating for about 100.
cards.access_notes: Access is for scheduled productions, classes, and events; consult the relevant event listing.

cards.title: Acopian Center for Ornithology
cards.subtitle: Collection-based natural-science learning
cards.notes: Use this as a research-focused stop to learn how a campus bird collection supports specialized classes and collection-based investigation.
cards.short_summary: A campus ornithology center with a historic mounted-bird collection and research library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Acopian Center houses a 2,000-plus-piece mounted bird collection and research library used by students, faculty, and the Lehigh Valley community.
cards.access_notes: Contact the center for information about research and collection access.
